chains.name: McDonald's
chains.src: McDonald's Singapore Nutrition Calculator (21 Nov 2026; McDonald's dates the figures December 2023). Calories as published; kilojoules are worked out. No sugar figures. No allergens: McDonald's Singapore's list leaves out sesame and shellfish. Sausage, ham and bacon are chicken (halal) Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: KFC
chains.src: KFC Singapore Nutrition Information (21 Nov 2026), per serving. Calories as published; kilojoules are worked out. No allergens: KFC Singapore's list leaves out sesame. Bacon and ham are chicken (halal) Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: Burger King
chains.src: Burger King Singapore menu pages, nutritional information per serving (Burger King dates the figures October 2025). Drinks are per 100 ml as published. No allergens: Burger King Singapore's list leaves out sesame. Halal: bacon and ham are turkey. Sodium left blank where the site prints a figure under 20 mg for a full item. Left out 2 item(s) whose calories don't match their macros: Ultimate Angus Classic BBQ (1780 kcal vs 449 from macros); Ultimate Angus Mushroom Swiss (1792 kcal vs 433 from macros); also bottled water and hot tea. (22 Nov 2026) Single pieces (1 wing, 1 nugget and so on) are the published pack divided by its count.

chains.name: SaladStop!
chains.src: SaladStop! Singapore website nutrition calculator (the JSON files its menu pages load), per item as served; Create-Your-Own dressings and toppings per portion. Calories as published. No allergens: SaladStop's tags leave out egg, soy and sesame. Not halal: bacon bits are pork. Left out 1 row(s) whose figures don't add up: Granola (131 kcal vs 405 from macros). Also left out 14 drinks with no fat figure or plain water (cold-pressed juices, immunity shots, still and sparkling water). (22 Nov 2026)

chains.name: The Daily Cut
chains.src: The Daily Cut macro calculator (thedailycut.sg/macro-calculator, linked as the menu's Nutritional Info), per portion of each build-your-own bowl component: a petite bowl is 2 bases, half a protein, 2 supplements, 1 topping, 1 dressing; regular 2 bases, 1 protein, 3 supplements; large 2 bases, 2 proteins, 3 supplements. Calories, protein, carbs and fat only. No allergens. Not halal certified. Left out 0 component(s) whose calories don't match their macros. (22 Nov 2026)
